title: What Is Void Swarm: Idle Survivor? A Full Overview
subtitle: A one-thumb swarm survivor for Android where your base keeps earning while you are away.
description: What is Void Swarm: Idle Survivor? An Android swarm-survivor with auto-firing weapons, an idle base, bosses and 12 languages. Free to play, rewarded ads only.
card: A plain-language overview of Void Swarm: Idle Survivor, what a run feels like, what the idle base does and how the free-to-play side works.

faq.q: What is Void Swarm: Idle Survivor?
faq.a: An Android game where you steer a lone drone with one thumb while your weapons fire automatically. Runs last about ten minutes and end with a boss. Between runs, an idle base earns Scrap and Research Points, even offline, to make the next run stronger.

faq.q: Is Void Swarm: Idle Survivor free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Ads are optional rewarded ads only, for example to revive or double a payout, and none interrupt a run. Purchases such as packs, boosts and cosmetics are optional, and Remove Ads turns every ad button into a free bonus.

faq.q: Which languages does Void Swarm: Idle Survivor support?
faq.a: English, Dutch, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Italian and Turkish, twelve languages in total.
